decision_vocabulary: pass | blocked | human_waived. human_waived is deliberately not pass: a waived gate stays machine-visible as not-passed, and the failed checks under it remain failed.
reason: Template only; expected checks and current evidence are missing.
diff_binding_note: workspace is the directory the gate actually resolved and ran in. diff_base is the revision the diff was taken against; diff_identity identifies the resulting diff. A gate whose subject is a change MUST record all four and MUST reject changed_file_count == 0 as blocked, never pass. An empty diff has a perfectly valid identity and a correct-looking revision of the wrong tree, so emptiness is evidence the gate never found its subject, not a valid observation.
check_result_vocabulary: result is passed | failed | not_run | error. A prerequisite-blocked check is not_run. Inapplicability is a different axis: set applicable false with an inapplicable_reason, and never record it as a result. source records provenance: executed | inspected | documented | asserted, matching the evidence hierarchy tiers. environment_suspected may be set only with positive corroborating evidence from an isolated re-run; it never converts a failure into a pass.
review_finding_shape: disposition is blocker | tech_debt | skippable and is the only field this gate reads. severity is Blocker | High | Medium | Low | Note and is human-facing. High folds to disposition blocker with risk_accepted true, which is what 'repair or receive explicit risk acceptance' already means. Approval must not contradict an unaccepted blocker.
